statement: SSH key with CRLF fails in OpenSSH with "error in libcrypto": normalize (tr -d '\r' + final newline) and validate with ssh-keygen -y before using a key materialized from the vault.
?ssh-format=openssh only works on the native field of an "SSH Key" item; ed25519 in PKCS#8 is not read by OpenSSH. Check the header before guessing the format.
wsl.exe expands $VAR on the Windows side before bash: a command with $ for WSL goes in a script file, never inline in -c.
A worktree created by Windows git has gitdir C:/... in its .git: from WSL, convert to /mnt/c/... and use --git-dir/--work-tree.

A data migration is accepted only by data proof: row counts per table at the source equal the destination (run on both sides, shown side by side). HTTP 200 or a container 'Up' is NOT acceptance; an empty app answers 200.

Before migrating an app, find where the RUNNING instance keeps its state (process env such as *_STATE_DIR, systemd unit, /var/lib/<app>, mounts), never the repo's dev copy. 10/10: thood's real data was /var/lib/thood (22 keys, 52 VPNs, 330 usage rows); the repo .state/ was empty and was restored first.
Copy a live SQLite with the online backup API (sqlite3 .backup / Connection.backup), source read-only, never cp of the file while the app runs (WAL/SHM lost or torn).
Before wiping a host, prove the snapshot contains every real state path found above (tar -tf | grep), not only the repos.

System specs, migration designs and acceptance criteria are written by the coordinator and checked against the owner's decisions; a worker's research doc is input, never spec. 10/10 a worker spec invented 'thood absorbs zenproxy+vpnai' against the owner's decision.
grep/test on a root-owned 600 file without sudo is a false negative: an 'add if missing' generator appended a new secret on every run (7 copies of a storage key, unreadable DB).
Never mix a && b || c in generated shell without if/parentheses: precedence silently skipped writing a private key.
Docker bind-mounting a FILE that does not exist yet creates a DIRECTORY at the host path; create the file before 'up'.
A version override in the host inventory silently beats the recipe's pin (mongo 8.0 on a CPU without AVX); a test must compare inventory and recipe versions.
Create a worker's git worktree from the same side the worker runs (inside the devcontainer); one created from the host stores a host gitdir path and is unusable in the container.

Dispatch a fix with the root cause already named (file:line + log line). Workers sent to 'investigate and fix' exhausted their turns 7 times on 10/10; with the cause in the prompt they finished in one pass.
Re-author only origin/main..HEAD; rewriting already pushed commits diverges history and blocks fast-forward.

Before editing, porting, adjusting, coding or migrating any system or tool, read its OFFICIAL documentation for the version in use (install guide/compose, config reference, changelog) and start from it. Every deviation is commented in place (difere do oficial: <reason>) and the source URL is cited. Applies to coordinators and goes into every worker prompt. 10/10 the homelab was built by trial and error (Komodo replSet/keyfile/X25519 invented; official compose is standalone and Komodo generates its keys) and each invention broke an apply.

KISS and SSOT are the default for EVERY implementation of any kind in every project, Tars included, unless the owner explicitly and unambiguously says otherwise for that specific case. Reimplementing what the tool already does, workarounds and duplicated logic are defects. Every spec and review states how it meets KISS and SSOT; deliveries report lines before and after.
